question: A hollow sphere has an outer radius of 6 cm and inner radius of 3 cm. What is the volume of this hollow sphere?
solution:
**Given:**

A hollow sphere has an outer radius of 6 cm and inner radius of 3 cm. 

Outer radius (R) = 6 cm

Inner radius (r) = 3 cm

**Formula:**

Volume of the hollow sphere

⇒ V = 4over3 × π × (R³ - r³)

Calculation:

⇒4over3 × π × (6³- 3³)

⇒4over3 × p × (216 - 27) 

⇒​​4over3 × ​p ​× (189)​​

⇒ 252 p ​ cm3

∴ **The volume of the given hollow sphere is 252 p cm**³**.**
